callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string representing the path to an existing project directory
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized for the given project directory and ready to answer extraction queries, or None if the CodeGraph backend is unavailable or cannot be initialized for this project

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_call_edges
callees.pre_condition: language is a string identifying a supported language (e.g., "typescript"); the CodeGraphExtractor instance has been successfully initialized for the project
callees.post_condition: Returns a dictionary mapping each caller identifier (a tuple of the form (caller_stem, caller_module) extracted from the project source) to a set of callee identifiers for the specified language. Each callee in a set is a function called by the corresponding caller.
